description: Trade beat: one item gained and one item lost in the same turn.
user_msg: I take the lantern and drop the torch.
turn: She pockets the brass lantern and lets the spent torch fall into the mud.
notes: BTS inventory notation is '+item' for a gain and '-item' (with detail in parens) for a loss. A gain and a loss in one turn share the inv key, space-separated, in the schema. 'take'/'drop' resolve to the task class.
